title: Operation: Atramentum/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: > I can't go to the wreck of Vesper Relay, it's too dangerous for a mere aspirant like me, but I want... no, I need to see Follie's Shadowgraph again.

> To make that happen, I need Nightmare Tatters. Find them on Vesper Relay and also in what you call Nightmare missions. These shreds are remnants of Follie's art. I think if we collect enough of those, we can reproduce a copy of her work right here in the relay. Then everyone can safely see it.
> Will you help me do that?” —Aspirant Zorba
> I can barely believe it. It worked. The Nightmare Tatters you collected have come together to create something amazing, a copy of Follie's Shadowgraph right here in the relay.
> Now everyone can see it, and I can commune with it every day. Just like my master did.
> And the best part? It can't hurt anybody.
> I can't thank you enough, but I did make a copy for you too. Display it with pride.” —Aspirant Zorba

- "By some miracle I can only attribute to Lua or the Void, Follie's Shadowgraph survived the destruction of Vesper Relay. Only, the blast left the work in desperate need of restoration. That's where you come in, Tenno. All of you. With every trip the Tenno take into the Shadowgraph, you do your part in restoring the work to its former glory. However horrifying that may be."
- "I wish I could be of more help."
- "Kozai wanted that Shadowgraph preserved. I wish I knew why."
- "The Arbiters wish to express their thanks."
- "I am seeing details in the Shadowgraph I never knew were there."
